description: Crates under apps/onchain/contracts that legitimately cannot carry their own test module. Every entry needs a stated reason. The list is enforced by scripts/check-contract-tests.mjs, which fails on an unknown crate, a missing reason, or an entry whose crate has since gained tests.

crates.name: test_utils
crates.reason: Shared Soroban test harness. It is a dev-dependency that every contract suite already compiles and exercises; it exposes no contract entry points of its own, so it has nothing to assert in isolation.

crates.name: event-golden
crates.reason: Test-only golden-fixture library for event serialization. It loads committed JSON fixtures at test time for other crates to assert against; it is a dev-dependency with no contract logic, so a self-test would only re-read the fixtures it exists to serve.
